[[File:Michael Riboulet 1998 Worlds.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Michael Riboulet, 1998 World Championship.]]
[[File:Michael Riboulet 1998 Worlds card.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Player card in ''Star Wars Insider'' #43.]]
'''Michael Riboulet''' was runner-up at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]] and the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] (United Kingdom). He was the first player in two Grand Finals. Gary Carman later named him as a Bristol playtest partner. Riboulet qualified through Kiffex Euro GenCon from Bristol.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
